title: DNA binding ability and cytotoxicity, cell cycle arrest and apoptosis inducing properties of a benzochromene derivative against K562 human leukemia cells.
authors: Hanifeh Ahagh, Mina; Dehghan, Gholamreza; Mahdavi, Majid; Hosseinpour Feizi, Mohammad Ali; Teimuri-Mofrad, Reza; Payami, Elmira; Mehdipour, Maryam; Rashtbari, Samaneh
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯并色烯衍生物与DNA的沟槽结合及对白血病细胞的凋亡诱导，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和对接模拟，但对象为小分子而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅含简单对接，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联有限。
abstract: Chromene and its derivatives are generally spread in nature. Heterocylic-based compounds like chromenes have displayed pharmacological activities. Chromene derivatives are critical due to some biological features such as anticancer activity. CML, chronic myelogenous leukemia, is a fatal malignancy determined by resistance to apoptosis and contains the Philadelphia chromosome. Induction of apoptosis is one of the main approaches in cancer therapy. In this research, benzochromene derivative, 2-amino-4-(4-methoxy phenyl)-4H-benzochromene-3-carbonitrile (4-MC) was tested for cytotoxic and apoptotic induction activities in the human leukemic K562 cell line. The MTT growth inhibition assay was used to determine the cellular growth and survival. Moreover, the binding attribute of 4-MC with double helix DNA was assessed by some spectroscopic and viscosity measurement, and also for docking analysis. 4-MC exhibited good cytotoxicity on K562 cell line and the IC(50) value was calculated to be 30 microM. Furthermore, the mechanisms of apoptosis induction were determined morphologically by fluorescence dual staining with acridine orange and ethidium bromide and cell cycle analysis was based on DNA content, as well as the presence of phosphatidyl serine on the outside of the cells by the flow cytometric method. The results showed that 4-MC had potent cytotoxic activity via sub-G1 cell cycle arrest and induction of apoptosis. The experimental and simulation studies reported that 4-MC binds to ctDNA through groove binding mode with the binding constant (K(b)) of 2.5 x 10(3) M(-1). These data represent a considerable anticancer potential of 4-MC and could be suggested for further pharmacological studies.
abstract_zh: 色烯及其衍生物在自然界中广泛分布。含有杂环的化合物如色烯已显示出药理活性。色烯衍生物因其某些生物学特性（如抗癌活性）而具有重要意义。慢性粒细胞白血病（CML）是一种致命性恶性肿瘤，其特征在于对细胞凋亡的抵抗，并含有费城染色体。诱导细胞凋亡是癌症治疗的主要方法之一。在本研究中，测试了苯并色烯衍生物2-氨基-4-(4-甲氧基苯基)-4H-苯并色烯-3-腈（4-MC）在人白血病K562细胞系中的细胞毒性和凋亡诱导活性。使用MTT生长抑制试验测定细胞生长和存活。此外，通过光谱法和粘度测量评估了4-MC与双螺旋DNA的结合特性，并进行了对接分析。4-MC对K562细胞系表现出良好的细胞毒性，计算得到的IC(50)值为30微摩尔。进一步地，通过荧光双重染色（吖啶橙和溴化乙锭）在形态学上确定了凋亡诱导机制，细胞周期分析基于DNA含量，以及通过流式细胞术检测细胞外表面磷脂酰丝氨酸的存在。结果表明，4-MC通过亚G1期细胞周期阻滞和诱导凋亡表现出强效的细胞毒性活性。实验和模拟研究显示，4-MC通过沟槽结合模式与ctDNA结合，结合常数（K(b)）为2.5 x 10(3) M(-1)。这些数据表明4-MC具有显著的抗癌潜力，并可能被建议用于进一步的药理学研究。
